description: This source file defines the code-behind for an ASP.NET Web Forms page that manages theory questions and course details in an online examination system. It contains event handlers for page load, button clicks, and dropdown list changes, handling database interactions like inserting questions and course details, updating question numbers, and navigating between pages.

classes.name: TheorySet
classes.description: Partial class for the TheorySet ASP.NET Web Forms page, handling course and question management functionalities.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event; currently commented out code related to session storage.

methods.name: selectB_Click
methods.description: Populates the course drop-down list based on the selected semester.

methods.name: AddQB_Click
methods.description: Adds a new theory question to the database, updates the question number, and displays an alert.

methods.name: setB_Click
methods.description: Adds exam details for the selected course to the database and navigates to the admin panel.

methods.name: clearB_Click
methods.description: Clears input text boxes for question data.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Transfers to the login page to log out.

methods.name: selectSemesterDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Updates the course drop-down list based on semester selection.

methods.name: SelectCourseDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Updates the question number based on selected course's existing questions in the database.
